rationale: Reusable closed limestone meshes preserve modeled shoulders and individually varied placement across a nonrepeating section. These asset production ceilings do not replace runtime performance budgets.
groundRationale: Separate 4m substrate supplies visible recessed joints; rooted original vegetation is retained as a distinct reusable patch rather than painted into the stone material.
sceneTriangleRationale: The accepted fracture silhouette needs up to 3900 triangles per stone: 153 courtyard stones alone can require 596700 triangles. A 750000-triangle scene asset ceiling retains a small slope diagnostic while eight shared unique variants bound resident geometry. Existing runtime performance budgets and encoded resource limits remain unchanged.
uvPolicy: The selected generated limestone surface and original procedural material detail intentionally reuse surface UVs across independently parameterized faces; no exclusive image atlas ownership or planar tile coverage is asserted. Every non-vegetation triangle still requires nondegenerate UVs.
